0022600148.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-3, 3rd in the Southeast, 8th in the East) are on a two-game losing streak as they host the Philadelphia 76ers (5-1, 1st in the Atlantic, 2nd in the East), who have won two straight. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back fracture), Jabari Walker (knee soreness), Joel Embiid (foot), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps strain), and Jaylen Brown is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, but in 2025-26 the Hornets lost the season series 1-2, including a 118-114 loss in Charlotte on March 28, 2026.
